stories.title: BNB Chain burns $1.2B in October tokens, but supply impact stays unclear
stories.summary: BNB Chain burned $1.2 billion worth of tokens in October, CryptoSlate reports. The burn is part of the network's routine token-reduction process. The report says the real effect on circulating supply is hard to confirm from the numbers given.
stories.whyItMatters: Holders watch burns as a scarcity signal for BNB, so unclear accounting makes it hard to judge the real supply effect.
whatToWatch: Any follow-up data on actual circulating-supply change
Future quarterly burn reports
questions: Does the burn reduce circulating supply, or mostly reflect paper value?

stories.title: Drift hacker moves $63M through Tornado Cash, clouding recovery hopes
stories.summary: The attacker behind the Drift protocol exploit has routed $63 million through Tornado Cash, the sanctioned mixing service, CryptoSlate reports. The move makes the funds harder to trace. It also puts any user recovery effort in doubt.
stories.whyItMatters: Mixer use after a major DeFi hack tests sanctions enforcement and shows how hard stolen-fund recovery remains for exploited protocols.
whatToWatch: Whether Drift reaches a return or bounty deal with the attacker
Any law-enforcement action tied to the laundered funds
questions: Can any of the $63M still be recovered or frozen?
Will regulators respond to the Tornado Cash use?

sources.title: Drift hacker washes $63M through Tornado Cash, leaving recovery claims in limbo

stories.title: JPMorgan models $385,000 Bitcoin in 10-year bull case, even as Dimon stays skeptical
stories.summary: JPMorgan has modeled a bull-case scenario in which Bitcoin reaches $385,000 within ten years, CryptoSlate reports. The projection stands next to CEO Jamie Dimon's long-standing public criticism of Bitcoin. It is one scenario among the bank's models, not a forecast of certainty.
stories.whyItMatters: A major bank's bull-case model carries weight with institutional allocators, but the gap with Dimon's own view shows Wall Street is still split on Bitcoin.
whatToWatch: Updates or revisions to JPMorgan's Bitcoin models
Further public comments from Dimon
Institutional Bitcoin allocation trends
questions: Does Dimon's skepticism shape JPMorgan's actual crypto services?

sources.title: JPMorgan models Bitcoin reaching $385,000 in 10-year bull case despite CEO Jamie Dimon’s criticism

stories.title: Analysts warn crowded recovery bets could worsen Bitcoin's next drop
stories.summary: CryptoSlate cites analysis warning that traders still positioned for a Bitcoin recovery could deepen the next selloff if those bets unwind. This is a speculative read on positioning, not a reported event. No specific trigger or timeline is given.
stories.whyItMatters: Crowded one-sided positioning can magnify price swings, which matters for risk management even though the scenario is speculative.
whatToWatch: Shifts in futures and options positioning data
Any sharp price move that tests this thesis
questions: What specific data shows traders are crowded into recovery bets?
How reliable is this kind of positioning analysis historically?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s next selloff could be amplified by the traders still betting on its recovery

stories.title: NGRAVE wallet users lose $2.65 million in phishing attack
stories.summary: Users of the NGRAVE hardware wallet lost a combined $2.65 million in a phishing attack, CryptoSlate reports. The incident adds to a run of attacks targeting crypto wallet holders. No details on the exact phishing method were given beyond the loss figure.
stories.whyItMatters: An attack against hardware-wallet users challenges a security model sold as safer against remote theft.
whatToWatch: Any response or mitigation steps from NGRAVE
Further victim reports or loss updates
questions: What was the actual attack vector: fake app, support scam, or seed-phrase theft?
Has NGRAVE confirmed how attackers reached users?

sources.title: Crypto wallet security crisis deepens as NGRAVE users face $2.65 million phishing attack

stories.title: US orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems as China opens the AI tool wider
stories.summary: The US government has ordered DeepSeek, the Chinese AI model, purged from federal systems, CryptoSlate reports, even as the company opens its technology more broadly. This is a tech and national-security story rather than a digital-asset one. No crypto-specific detail is included in the source.
stories.whyItMatters: The move signals tightening US scrutiny of Chinese tech products, a regulatory posture that can spill into how US agencies treat other foreign-linked digital technologies, including crypto infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Whether the ban extends beyond federal systems
China's and DeepSeek's response
questions: What specific security concern triggered the order?
Does this signal a broader US stance on Chinese AI or tech products?

sources.title: US orders DeepSeek purge from federal systems as Chinese AI rival opens its technology to the world

stories.title: Super League shareholders approve Metaplanet-linked 2,100 BTC investment
stories.summary: Shareholders of Super League approved a plan tied to Metaplanet for a 2,100 BTC investment, CryptoSlate reports. The vote clears the way for the purchase to proceed. No funding or timeline details beyond the approval were given.
stories.whyItMatters: It is another public company moving corporate treasury funds into Bitcoin, extending the accumulation strategy popularized by MicroStrategy and Metaplanet.
whatToWatch: Confirmation that the 2,100 BTC purchase is completed
How the investment is funded
questions: What is the total cost of the 2,100 BTC purchase?
Is this a direct Metaplanet stake or a separate corporate deal?

stories.title: Musk and Anthropic unveil AI wealth-sharing plans worth over $110 billion
stories.summary: Elon Musk and Anthropic have announced AI-related wealth-sharing plans that could total over $110 billion, CryptoSlate reports. The announcement concerns AI company structures, not digital assets directly. No crypto component is described in the source.
stories.whyItMatters: Large AI wealth-distribution plans shape the broader tech-investment landscape that crypto markets often track, though this story has no direct digital-asset angle.
whatToWatch: Details on how the wealth-sharing plans would be structured and funded
questions: What form would the $110 billion sharing take, and who qualifies?
Is there any link to tokenized or crypto-based distribution?

stories.title: Bitcoin fell 1.3% as Nasdaq-100 dropped 5.5% in last week's tech selloff
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.3% last week while the Nasdaq-100 lost 5.5% during a broader tech-stock selloff, CryptoSlate reports. Bitcoin's smaller decline stands out against the sharper drop in high-growth tech equities. The report does not give a cause for the divergence.
stories.whyItMatters: Relative resilience against tech-stock losses feeds the ongoing debate over whether Bitcoin is decoupling from equity risk sentiment.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin keeps diverging from Nasdaq-100 moves in coming weeks
Any reassertion of the usual Bitcoin-equity correlation
questions: Is this divergence a real decoupling or a short-term gap?

stories.title: 110 bot wallets dominate RLUSD payments on the XRP Ledger
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that just 110 bot wallets account for most RLUSD payment activity on the XRP Ledger. The finding raises questions about how much of the network's reported activity surge reflects genuine use versus automated flows. No detail is given on who operates the wallets.
stories.whyItMatters: If headline activity is mostly automated rather than organic, it undercuts claims about RLUSD's real-world payment adoption.
whatToWatch: Any response from Ripple on the bot-wallet activity
Independent checks of RLUSD usage patterns
questions: Who controls the 110 wallets, and what is their purpose?
Is the activity wash trading, market-making, or legitimate payment flow?

sources.title: XRP Ledger’s booming activity faces scrutiny as 110 bot wallets dominate RLUSD payments
